question: When the difference between compound interest, compounded annually, and simple interest for three years is ₹217 at 10% interest per annum, the principal is ₹_____.
solution:
**Given:**

Difference between Compound Interest (CI) and Simple Interest (SI) = ₹217

Rate (r) = 10% per annum

Time (t) = 3 years

**Formula used:**

Difference between CI and SI for 3 years = P × (r/100)² × (3 + r/100)

**Calculation:**

217 = P × (10/100)² × (3 + 10/100)

⇒ 217 = P × (1/100) × (3 + 0.1)

⇒ 217 = P × (1/100) × 3.1

⇒ P = 217 × 100 / 3.1

⇒ P = ₹7000

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
